title: Balance the edges of a raw Markdown copy, behind an opt-in setting
summary: Opt-in preview.rawCopy.balanceEdges (off: CR-480's verbatim cut): inside a construct copy its content only; crossing a boundary add the missing delimiters (inline markers, fences, table header, list marker, heading). Unplaced edges snap in both. Stacked on CR-480; 1 open question.
